cooked: The P2MR/P2QR distinction is more than an efficiency tradeoff: it determines whether an output can later fall back to ECC. For P2MR, a PQC leaf does not make an output quantum-safe if another committed leaf remains spendable with ECC; disabling ECC later may strand funds whose owners cannot use the PQC path. It may help to state that recovery assumption explicitly in the security table.
